summary: Selects one generated texture output from a referenced Substance TOP for independent routing and processing.

key_params.name: output
key_params.note: Generated Substance output texture to select.

common_gotchas: The selected outputs depend on the loaded Substance graph.
Use separate Substance Select TOPs for maps that need independent processing or material assignment.
Changing the Substance source can change the available Output menu entries.
The Output menu is dynamic, so saved names can go stale when the .sbsar changes.
key_concepts: Substance Select TOP extracts one generated texture from a Substance TOP.
The available Output menu entries are dynamic and depend on the referenced Substance TOP graph.
Multiple Substance Select TOPs are useful when maps need independent filtering or material routing.
Changing the source Substance TOP can change which output names are valid.
